units.en: Today virtuous edicts leave Your tent and wholesome wind blows boundless—banners wheel south and the Yangzi and Han roll up like mats;
units.literal: Now the sacred court's virtuous sound issues from the curtain and canopy; pure wind soars without exterior limit—martial banners point south—the Yangzi and Han are swept like mat rolls;

units.zh: 干戈西征，羌蠻慕化，誠闡四門之秋，興禮教之日也。
units.en: arms march west while Qiang and Man yearn for civilization—the hour to open every gate and lift ritual teaching.
units.literal: spears west campaign—Qiang and Man admire transformation—it is truly the season for opening the four gates and the day for raising ritual instruction.

units.zh: 故髦俊聞聲而響赴，殊才望險而雲集。
units.en: Fine men race toward Your summons; odd talents flock despite hardship.
units.literal: Hence splendid talents hearing the sound echo and hasten; unusual talents sighting peril cloud-gather.

units.zh: 虛高館以俟賢，設重爵以待士，急善過於饑渴，用人疾于影響，杜佞諂之門，廢鄭聲之樂，混清六合，實由乎此。
units.en: Leave great halls open for talent, stack noble titles for scholars, thirst for goodness more than food or drink, appoint men swift as echo—shut flattery's door and silence licentious music—purifying the realm begins here.
units.literal: Empty lofty lodges to await worthies; set weighty noble ranks to await scholars; urgency toward good surpasses hunger and thirst; employing men quick as shadow and echo—block flattery's gates; abolish Zheng music—clarifying and purifying the six directions truly proceeds from this.

units.zh: 雖西北有未羈之寇，殊漠有不朝之虜，征之則勞師，得之則無益，故班固云：'有其地不可耕而食，得其人不可臣而畜，來則懲而禦之，去則備而守之。
units.en: Northwest raiders and desert tribes who skip court cost dear to chase and yield little gain—Ban Gu warned: their soil will not feed us, their men will not obey—strike when they come, guard when they flee.
units.literal: Though northwest have unsubdued raiders and distant desert have captives who do not court—punishing them wearies troops; obtaining them brings no benefit—hence Ban Gu said: 'Having their land, one cannot plow and eat; having their people, one cannot subject and herd them—when they come, chastise and withstand them; when they depart, prepare and guard them.

units.zh: '蓋安邊之術也。」
units.en: That is how borders stay quiet."
units.literal: This covers the art of pacifying frontiers.'"

units.zh: 又策曰：「吳、蜀恃險，今既蕩平。
units.en: The examination continued: "Wu and Shu trusted their barriers—both are crushed.
units.literal: Again the examination said: "Wu and Shu relied on peril—now they have been swept flat.

units.zh: 蜀人服化，無攜貳之心；
units.en: Shu accepts civilization—no hint of split loyalty;
units.literal: Shu people submit to transformation—without hearts of divided allegiance;

units.zh: 而吳人趑雎，屢作妖寇。
units.en: Wu vacillates and stirs trouble again and again.
units.literal: but Wu people hesitate and rear—repeatedly acting demonic bandits.

units.zh: 豈蜀人敦朴，易可化誘；
units.en: Are Shu folk simpler—easier to win;
units.literal: Is it that Shu people are honest and plain—easy to transform and entice;

units.zh: 吳人輕銳，難安易動乎？
units.en: Wu quicker and keener—harder to settle?
units.literal: Wu people light and keen—hard to pacify and easy to stir?

units.zh: 今將欲綏靜新附，何以為先？」
units.en: How shall we calm the newly conquered—what comes first?"
units.literal: Now desiring to pacify and quiet the newly attached—what comes first?"

units.zh: 對曰：「臣聞漢末分崩，英雄鼎峙，蜀棲岷隴，吳據江表。
units.en: He answered: "Late Han shattered—warlords tripod-balanced—Shu clung to Min and Long, Wu gripped the eastern rivers.
units.literal: He replied: "I have heard that at Han's end it split and collapsed—heroes tripod-stood—Shu perched on Min and Long—Wu held the lands beyond the Yangzi.

units.zh: 至大晉龍興，應期受命，文皇運籌，安樂順軌；
units.en: Great Jin rose on time—the Literary Emperor laid plans—Anle submitted and followed the track;
units.literal: When great Jin dragon rose, answering the period and receiving the mandate—Literary Emperor laid plans—Anle followed the track;

units.zh: 聖上潛謀，歸命向化。
units.en: Your Majesty shaped destiny in secret until foes bent to civilization.
units.literal: the sacred sovereign secretly plotted—submitting mandate toward transformation.

units.zh: 蜀染化日久，風教遂成；
units.en: Shu soaked in influence until custom hardened;
units.literal: Shu long steeped in transformation—wind instruction thereupon completed;

units.zh: 吳始初附，未改其化，非為蜀人敦愨而吳人易動也。
units.en: Wu submitted late—habits lag—not because Shu is steadier by nature.
units.literal: Wu only lately attached—not yet changed in transformation—it is not that Shu people are honest and sincere while Wu people easy to stir.

units.zh: 然殊俗遠境，風土不同，吳阻長江，舊俗輕悍。
units.en: Frontier peoples differ—Wu hugs the great river—its temper stays quick and bold.
units.literal: Yet alien customs and distant borders—wind and soil differ—Wu blocks the long Yangzi—old customs light and fierce.

units.zh: 所安之計，當先籌其人士，使雲翔閶闔，進其賢才，待以異禮；
units.en: Peace them by lifting local gentlemen—bring talent to court with honors;
units.literal: The plan for settling them ought first to arrange their gentlemen and scholars—making them cloud-soar at Chang'e Gate—advance their worthy talents—treat them with unusual ritual;

units.zh: 明選牧伯，致以威風；
units.en: pick firm governors to lend dignity;
units.literal: clearly select shepherds and elders—bring to them awe-inspiring wind;

units.zh: 輕其賦斂，將順咸悅，可以永保無窮，長為人臣者也。」
units.en: ease taxes and follow local feeling—they stay pleased subjects forever."
units.literal: lighten their levies—lead compliant—all pleased—can eternally preserve without limit—long be men's ministers.'"

units.zh: 又策曰：「聖人稱如有王者，必世而後仁。
units.en: The examination asked: "The sage said benevolent rule needs a generation to ripen.
units.literal: Again the examination said: "The sage pronounced—if there were a king—it must be a generation before benevolence.

units.zh: 今天成地平，大化無外，雖匈奴未羈，羌、氐驕黠，將修文德以綏之，舞干戚以來之，故兵戈載戢，武夫寢息。
units.en: Heaven and earth align—culture spreads beyond borders—though Xiongnu remain free and Qiang or Di grow bold, civil virtue will soothe them and the shield-dance summon them—arms rest and soldiers sleep.
units.literal: Now Heaven completes and earth levels—great transformation without exterior—though Xiongnu not bridled, Qiang and Di arrogant and cunning—will cultivate pattern virtue to pacify them, dance shields and axes to draw them—hence weapons stored away—warriors sleep and rest.

units.zh: 如此，已可消鋒刃為佃器，罷尚方武庫之用未邪？」
units.en: May we yet beat swords into ploughshares and idle the armories?"
units.literal: Thus—is it already possible to melt blades into farming tools and cease employment of the imperial workshops and martial arsenals?"

units.zh: 對曰：「夫唐堯曆載，頌聲乃作；
units.en: He answered: "Even under Yao ages passed before songs of praise rose;
units.literal: He replied: "As for Tang Yao passing years—only then did praise sound arise;

units.zh: 文、武相承，禮樂大同。
units.en: Kings Wen and Wu handed power until ritual and music harmonized.
units.literal: Wen and Wu succeeded each other—ritual and music greatly unified.

units.zh: 清一八紘，綏蕩無外，萬國順軌，海內斐然。
units.en: They unified the zones, soothed every frontier, aligned ten thousand states—the realm glowed.
units.literal: Purifying one and eight cords—pacifying vastness without exterior—myriad states follow the track—within the seas splendid.

units.zh: 雖復被髮之鄉，徒跣之國，皆習章甫而入朝，要衣裳以磬折。
units.en: Even bare-headed barefoot realms donned court caps and bent in silk—everyone aped the Middle Kingdom.
units.literal: Though again lands of disheveled hair, states of bare feet—all practiced black caps and entered court—girdled robes and folded like sounding stone.

units.zh: 夫大舜之德，猶有三苗之征；
units.en: Great Shun still campaigned against San Miao;
units.literal: As for great Shun's virtue—still there was the punishment expedition against San Miao;

units.zh: 以周之盛，獫狁為寇。
units.en: at Zhou's height the Xianyun still raided.
units.literal: considering Zhou's flourishing—the Xianyun were bandits.

units.zh: 雖有文德，又須武備。
units.en: Civil virtue still needs martial readiness.
units.literal: Though there is pattern virtue, martial preparedness is also needed.

units.zh: 備預不虞，古之善教；
units.en: Readiness for surprise is ancient wisdom;
units.literal: Preparing against unforeseen events is good teaching of antiquity;

units.zh: 安不忘危，聖人常誡。
units.en: in peace remember peril—the sages say so still.
units.literal: in peace not forgetting danger—sages constantly warn.

units.zh: 無為罷武庫之常職，鑠鋒刃為佃器。
units.en: Do not idle the armories or beat every sword into a ploughshare yet.
units.literal: It is not fitting to abolish the standing duty of martial arsenals or melt blades into farming tools.

units.zh: 自可倒戢干戈，苞以獸皮，將帥之士，使為諸侯，于散樂休風，未為不泰也。」
units.en: Lay arms aside wrapped in hide, enfeoff your captains if you will—under loosened music and gentle airs that still counts as peace."
units.literal: Of itself one may store spears inverted, wrap them in beast hide, make commanders and generals into feudal lords—amid dissolving music and restorative wind, it is not untranquil.'"

units.zh: 又策曰：「夫法令之設，所以隨時制也。
units.en: The examination continued: "Laws fit their age.
units.literal: Again the examination said: "As for the establishment of laws and orders—it is to regulate according to the times.

units.zh: 時險則峻法以取平，時泰則寬網以將化。
units.en: Danger demands stern statutes; calm seasons favor lenient nets.
units.literal: When times are perilous then harsh law to obtain peace; when times are tranquil then loose nets to lead transformation.

units.zh: 今天下太平，四方無事，百姓承德，將就無為而乂。
units.en: Today the realm is still—folk receive virtue—and government nears wuwei ease.
units.literal: Now all under Heaven is peaceful—the four directions without affair—common people receive virtue—about to approach doing nothing and governing.

units.zh: 至於律令，應有所損益不？」
units.en: Should statutes shrink or grow?"
units.literal: As for statutes and ordinances—ought there be reduction or augmentation?"

units.zh: 對曰：「臣聞五帝殊禮，三王異教，故或禪讓以光政，或干戈以攻取。
units.en: He answered: "Five Emperors differed in rite, Three Kings in teaching—some yielded thrones, others conquered.
units.literal: He replied: "I have heard the Five Emperors had different ritual—the Three Kings different teaching—hence some abdicated to brighten government, some used arms to attack and take.

units.zh: 至於興禮樂以和人，流清風以寧俗，其歸一也。
units.en: Yet ritual and music calm the people—pure custom ends the same.
units.literal: When it comes to raising ritual and music to harmonize men, flowing pure wind to quiet customs—their return is one.

units.zh: 今誠風教大同，四海無虞，人皆感化，去邪從正。
units.en: Culture now unifies; beyond the frontiers all is still—men turn from vice.
units.literal: Now truly wind and teaching greatly unify—the four seas without anxiety—all transformed—leave evil and follow right.

units.zh: 夫以堯、舜之盛，而猶設象刑；
units.en: Even Yao and Shun kept model punishments;
units.literal: Consider Yao and Shun's flourishing—and still they established symbolic punishments;

units.zh: 殷、周之隆，而甫侯制律。
units.en: glorious Yin and Zhou still ordered the codes through the Marquis of Fu.
units.literal: Yin and Zhou's grandeur—and the Marquis of Fu regulated statutes.

units.zh: 律令之存，何妨於政。
units.en: Keeping the code on the books harms nothing.
units.literal: That statutes and ordinances exist—what harm to government?

units.zh: 若乃大道四達，禮樂交通，凡人修行，黎庶勵節，刑罰懸而不用，律令存而無施，適足以隆太平之雅化，飛仁風乎無外矣。」
units.en: When the Way runs free and ritual joins music, common conduct rises—laws may hang unused yet stand ready—enough to crown an age of peace and spread kindness beyond the borders."
units.literal: If the great way runs four ways open—ritual and music intercourse—all men cultivate conduct—black-haired folk urge integrity—punishments hang unused—statutes exist unapplied—just sufficient to exalt the elegant transformation of great peace—and send benevolent wind flying without exterior.'"

units.zh: 又策曰：「昔帝舜以二八成功，文王以多士興周。
units.en: The examination asked: "Shun used eight ministers; Wen built Zhou with many talents.
units.literal: Again the examination said: "Of old Emperor Shun succeeded with the Eight Ministers; King Wen raised Zhou with many scholars.

units.zh: 夫制化在於得人，而賢才難得。
units.en: Order rests on men—yet worthies are rare.
units.literal: Transformation lies in obtaining men—yet worthy talent is hard to obtain.

units.zh: 今大統始同，宜搜才實。
units.en: The empire has just united—seek real ability.
units.literal: Now the great unification has just aligned—it is fitting to search out substantial talent.

units.zh: 州郡有貢薦之舉，猶未獲出群卓越之倫。
units.en: Regions recommend candidates—yet none leap ahead of the pack.
units.literal: Prefectures and commanderies have nomination for tribute—still they have not obtained those who surpass the crowd and tower.

units.zh: 將時無其人？
units.en: Are the times empty of genius?
units.literal: Is it that the times lack such persons?

units.zh: 有而致之未得其理也？」
units.en: Or do we fail to fetch them rightly?"
units.literal: Or they exist but summoning them has not obtained the right pattern?"

units.zh: 對曰：「臣聞興化立法，非賢無以光其道；
units.en: He answered: "Law and transformation need worthies to shine.
units.literal: He replied: "I have heard that raising transformation and establishing law—without worthies none can brighten its way;

units.zh: 平世理亂，非才無以宣其業。
units.en: Peace and peril alike need talent enacted.
units.literal: ordering an age and settling chaos—without talent none can proclaim its enterprise.

units.zh: 上自皇羲，下及帝王，莫不張惶綱以羅遠，飛仁風以被物。
units.en: From high antiquity every throne cast its net wide and sent kindness abroad.
units.literal: Above from august Xi down to emperors and kings—none failed to spread the guiding net to catch the distant, fly benevolent wind to cover things.

units.zh: 故得賢則教興，失人則政廢。
units.en: Find talent and instruction thrives—miss it and policy rots.
units.literal: Hence obtain worthies then teaching rises; lose men then government wastes.

units.zh: 今四海一統，萬里同風，州郡貢秀孝，台府簡良才，以八紘之廣，兆庶之眾，豈當無卓越俊逸之才乎！
units.en: The realm is one—regions send nominees—the court selects—with so vast a population how could excellence be absent?
units.literal: Now the four seas unified, ten thousand li one wind—prefectures tribute cultivated and filial—grand offices pick good talent—with the eight cords' breadth and the multitude's mass—how could there fail to be surpassing and superior persons!

units.zh: 譬猶南海不少明月之寶，大宛不乏千里之駒也。
units.en: The south still hides luminous pearls; Ferghana still breeds swift horses.
units.literal: It is like the Southern Sea not lacking bright-moon pearls—Dayuan not lacking thousand-li foals.

units.zh: 異哲難見，遠數難睹，故堯、舜太平之化，二八由舜而甫顯，殷湯革王之命，伊尹負鼎而方用。
units.en: Rare genius hides far off—the Eight Ministers shone only after Shun; Yi Yin carried his cauldron before Tang used him.
units.literal: Different sages are hard to see—distant reckonings hard to behold—hence Yao and Shun's peaceful transformation—the Eight Ministers through Shun only then appeared—Tang of Yin altering the king's mandate—Yi Yin bore the tripod only then was employed.

units.zh: 當今聖朝禮亡國之士，接遐裔之人，或貂蟬於帷幄，或剖符於千里，巡狩必有呂公之遇，宵夢必有岩穴之感。
units.en: Today You honor fallen dynasties' men—some advise within the tent, some govern regions—like kings who meet worthies on tour or in dream.
units.literal: Now the sacred court treats scholars of fallen states, receives men from distant shores—some with marten tails in the curtain—some splitting tallies across a thousand li—tour inspections surely meet a Duke Lü—midnight dreams surely touch cliff caves.

units.zh: 賢俊之出，可企踵而待也。」
units.en: Worthy men will appear—wait on tiptoe."
units.literal: The emergence of worthy excellence—can stand on tiptoe and await.'"

units.zh: 時九州秀孝策無逮譚者。
units.en: None in the nine provinces out-argued Tan.
units.literal: At that time none of the nine provinces' cultivated and filial examination answers matched Tan.

units.zh: 譚素以才學為東土所推。
units.en: The east already prized Tan's scholarship.
units.literal: Tan always by talent and learning was esteemed by the eastern lands.

units.zh: 同郡劉頌時為廷尉，見之歎息曰：「不悟鄉里乃有如此才也！」
units.en: Liu Song of the same commandery, then Commandant of Justice, sighed on seeing him: "I did not realize my village held such talent!"
units.literal: Liu Song of the same commandery was then Commandant of Justice—seeing him sighed: "I did not realize my village held such talent!"

units.zh: 博士王濟于眾中嘲之曰：「五府初開，群公辟命，采英奇於仄陋，拔賢俊於岩穴。
units.en: Wang Ji sneered before guests: "High office hunts talent in hovels and caves.
units.literal: Erudite Wang Ji mocked him before the crowd: "The five offices newly opened—lords summon commands—gather marvels from humble lanes—pull worthies from cliff caves.

units.zh: 君吳、楚之人，亡國之余，有何秀異而應斯舉？」
units.en: You—Wu-Chu remnant—what pearl earns this pick?"
units.literal: You are a Wu-Chu man—a survivor of a fallen state—what excellence responds to this summons?"

units.zh: 譚答曰：「秀異固產于方外，不出於中域也。
units.en: Tan replied: "Brilliance grows on the margins—not only in the heartland.
units.literal: Tan answered: "Excellence indeed is produced beyond the regions—not emerging from the central plain.

units.zh: 是以明珠文貝，生於江、鬱之濱；
units.en: Pearls and cowries shine by Yangzi bays;
units.literal: Hence bright pearls and patterned shells—are born on Jiang and Yu's shores;

units.zh: 夜光之璞，出乎荊、藍之下。
units.en: night-glow jade rises from Jing and indigo mines.
units.literal: night-shining unwrought jade—comes out below Jing and Lan.

units.zh: 故以人求之，文王生於東夷，大禹生於西羌。
units.en: Seek men widely—King Wen rose among eastern tribes; Yu among western Qiang.
units.literal: Hence by men seeking them—King Wen was born among eastern Yi—Great Yu born among western Qiang.

units.zh: 子弗聞乎？
units.en: Have you heard?
units.literal: Have you not heard?

units.zh: 昔武王克商，遷殷頑民於洛邑，諸君得非其苗裔乎？」
units.en: When Wu conquered Shang he moved Yin loyalists to Luoyi—might you stem from them?"
units.literal: Of old King Wu conquered Shang—transferred Yin stubborn people to Luoyi—you gentlemen could they not be their descendants?"

units.zh: 濟又曰：「夫危而不持，顛而不扶，至於君臣失位，國亡無主，凡在冠帶，將何所取哉！」
units.en: Ji pressed: "When the peril goes unmet—throne falls—what good were belted ministers!"
units.literal: Ji again said: "When danger comes yet none uphold—when overturn comes yet none prop—reaching to lord and minister losing position—state perishing without lord—all within cap and sashes—what can they take?"

units.zh: 答曰：「籲！
units.en: Tan answered: "Ah!
units.literal: He answered: "Alas!

units.zh: 存亡有運，興衰有期，天之所廢，人不能支。
units.en: Rise and ruin ride fate—what Heaven ends no hand upholds.
units.literal: Survival and perdition have their fortune—rise and fall their period—what Heaven casts off—men cannot sustain.

units.zh: 徐偃修仁義而失國，仲尼逐魯而逼齊，段幹偃息而成名，諒否泰有時，曷人力之所能哉！」
units.en: Kind Xu lost his realm; Confucius fled Lu; Duan Ganmu won fame from seclusion—fortune turns—what can effort do?"
units.literal: Xu Yan practiced benevolence and righteousness yet lost the state—Confucius fled Lu and was pressed toward Qi—Duan Ganmu rested at home yet achieved fame—indeed obstructed and smooth have their times—how can human force manage!"

units.zh: 濟甚禮之。
units.en: Ji treated him with deep respect.
units.literal: Ji greatly honored him.

units.zh: 尋除郎中，遷太子舍人、本國中正。
units.en: Soon made Gentleman of the Palace, then attendant to the heir and provincial evaluator.
units.literal: Shortly appointed Gentleman of the Palace—promoted to Household Attendant to the Heir Apparent and provincial impartial judge for his native commandery.

units.zh: 以母憂去職。
units.en: He resigned for mother's mourning.
units.literal: He left office for mourning his mother.

units.zh: 服闋，為鄄城令，過濮水，作《莊子贊》以示功曹。
units.en: After mourning he governed Juancheng—crossing the Pu he wrote "In Praise of Zhuangzi" for his clerk.
units.literal: When mourning ended—he became magistrate of Juancheng—crossing the Pu River—composed "In Praise of Zhuangzi" to show his merit clerk.

units.zh: 而廷掾張延為作答教，其文甚美。
units.en: Clerk Zhang Yan answered his essay in splendid prose.
units.literal: But clerk Zhang Yan of the commandery composed a reply instruction—the text very fine.

units.zh: 譚異而薦之，遂見升擢。
units.en: Tan admired it and recommended Zhang—who rose in rank.
units.literal: Tan marveling recommended him—thereupon saw promotion.

units.zh: 及譚為廬江，延已為淮陵太守。
units.en: When Tan ruled Lujiang, Zhang Yan already governed Huailing.
units.literal: When Tan became prefect of Lujiang—Zhang Yan had already become prefect of Huailing.

units.zh: 又舉寒族周訪為孝廉，訪果立功名，時以譚為知人。
units.en: He nominated Zhou Fang from a humble clan—Fang earned glory—men praised Tan's eye.
units.literal: He also nominated cold-clan Zhou Fang as Filial and Incorrupt—Fang indeed established merit and fame—the age deemed Tan knew men.

units.zh: 以父墓毀去官。
units.en: His father's tomb collapsed—he quit office.
units.literal: Because father's tomb damaged—left office.

units.zh: 尋除尚書郎。
units.en: Soon named Gentleman of the Secretariat.
units.literal: Shortly appointed Gentleman of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 永甯初，出為郟令。
units.en: In Yongning he became magistrate of Jia.
units.literal: At the beginning of Yongning—went out as magistrate of Jia.

units.zh: 于時兵亂之後，境內饑饉，譚傾心撫䘏。
units.en: After war famine stalked his district—Tan poured himself into relief.
units.literal: At that time after military chaos—within the borders famine—Tan poured heart into comforting relief.

units.zh: 司徒王戎聞而善之，出穀三百斛以助之。
units.en: Wang Rong heard and sent three hundred hu of grain.
units.literal: Minister Wang Rong hearing praised him—issued grain three hundred hu to assist.

units.zh: 譚甚有政績，再遷廬江內史，加綏遠將軍。
units.en: His rule excelled—he rose to interior governor of Lujiang with the Pacify-the-Distant generalship.
units.literal: Tan had very good administrative merit—promoted again to Interior Governor of Lujiang—added General Who Pacifies the Distance.

units.zh: 時石冰之党陸圭等屯據諸縣，譚遣司馬褚敦討平之。
units.en: When Lu Gui's band held counties for Shi Bing, Tan sent Chu Dun to crush them.
units.literal: At that time Shi Bing's faction Lu Gui and others garrisoned and held various counties—Tan dispatched Marshal Chu Dun to punish and pacify.

units.zh: 又遣別軍擊冰都督孟徐，獲其驍率。
units.en: Another column struck Meng Xu—taking his fiercest captain.
units.literal: He also dispatched separate troops to strike Bing's commander-in-chief Meng Xu—captured his fierce leader.

units.zh: 以功封都亭侯，食邑千戶，賜絹千匹。
units.en: For merit he became Village Marquis—thousand-house fief and thousand bolts of silk.
units.literal: By merit ennobled Village Marquis—food estate thousand households—silk thousand bolts.

units.zh: 陳敏之亂，吳士多為其所逼。
units.en: When Chen Min rebelled many Wu scholars served under duress.
units.literal: During Chen Min's rebellion—Wu scholars many were forced by him.

units.zh: 顧榮先受敏官，而潛謀圖之。
units.en: Gu Rong took Chen Min's post but secretly schemed against him.
units.literal: Gu Rong first received office from Min yet secretly plotted against him.

units.zh: 譚不悟榮旨，露檄遠近，極言其非，由此為榮所怨。
units.en: Tan missed Rong's plan—sent a harsh proclamation—earning Rong's hate.
units.literal: Tan did not grasp Rong's intent—published a proclamation far and near—stating to the utmost his wrongs—thereby was resented by Rong.

units.zh: 又在郡政嚴，而與上司多忤。
units.en: He governed strictly and clashed with superiors.
units.literal: Also in the commandery his government was strict—yet with superiors many clashed.

units.zh: 揚州刺史劉陶素與譚不善，因法收譚，下壽陽獄。
units.en: Liu Tao, who disliked Tan, jailed him at Shouyang.
units.literal: Inspector Liu Tao of Yang Province by nature with Tan not on good terms—thereby by law seized Tan—cast into Shouyang prison.

units.zh: 鎮東將軍周馥與譚素相親善，理而出之。
units.en: Zhou Fu, eastern commander and Tan's friend, freed him.
units.literal: General Who Guards the East Zhou Fu by nature with Tan mutually intimate and kind—reasoned and released him.

units.zh: 及甘卓討馥，百姓奔散，馥謂譚已去，遣人視之，而更移近馥。
units.en: When Gan Zhuo struck Zhou Fu and folk fled, Fu thought Tan gone—but Tan moved closer.
units.literal: When Gan Zhuo attacked Fu—common people scattered and fled—Fu thought Tan had gone—sent men to look—yet Tan had moved nearer Fu.

units.zh: 馥歎曰：「吾嘗謂華令思是臧子源之疇，今果效矣。」
units.en: Fu sighed: "I likened Tan to Zang Hong—he proves it now."
units.literal: Fu sighed: "I once said Hua Ling Si was of Zang Ziyuan's class—now indeed he proves it."

units.zh: 甘卓嘗為東海王越所捕，下令敢有匿者誅之，卓投譚而免。
units.en: Gan Zhuo, once hunted by Sima Yue, hid with Tan and lived.
units.literal: Gan Zhuo once was seized by Sima Yue, Prince of Donghai—who issued an order that whoever harbored him would be executed—Zhuo threw himself on Tan and escaped.

units.zh: 及此役也，卓遣人求之曰：「華侯安在？
units.en: In that war Zhuo's men asked, "Where is Marquis Hua?
units.literal: When this campaign occurred—Zhuo sent men seeking him saying: "Where is Marquis Hua?

units.zh: 吾甘揚威使也。」
units.en: We come from Gan Zhuo's staff."
units.literal: I am Gan Yangwei's emissary."

units.zh: 譚答不知，遺絹二匹以遣之。
units.en: Tan feigned ignorance and gave two bolts of silk.
units.literal: Tan answered not knowing—sent two bolts of silk to dismiss them.

units.zh: 使反，告卓。
units.en: The messenger reported back.
units.literal: The messenger returned—told Zhuo.

units.zh: 卓曰：「此華侯也。」
units.en: Zhuo said, "That was Marquis Hua."
units.literal: Zhuo said: "That is Marquis Hua."

units.zh: 復求之，譚已亡矣。
units.en: They searched again—Tan had fled.
units.literal: Seeking again—Tan had already fled.

units.zh: 後為紀瞻所薦，而為顧榮所止遏，遂數年不得調。
units.en: Ji Zhan recommended him but Gu Rong blocked—years passed without a post.
units.literal: Later recommended by Ji Zhan—yet blocked by Gu Rong—thereupon several years obtained no reassignment.

units.zh: 建興初，元帝命為鎮東軍諮祭酒。
units.en: At the beginning of Jianxing, Emperor Yuan appointed him army libationer-consultant.
units.literal: At the beginning of Jianxing, Emperor Yuan appointed him Libationer Consultant of the Army Defending the East.

units.zh: 譚博學多通，在府無事，乃著書三十卷，名曰《辨道》，上箋進之，帝親自覽焉。
units.en: Idle at headquarters he wrote thirty chapters, Discerning the Way, which the prince read.
units.literal: Tan was broadly learned and vastly informed—in the bureau nothing to do—thereupon composed thirty fascicles titled "Discerning the Way"—presented memorial advancing it—the emperor personally reviewed.

units.zh: 轉丞相軍諮祭酒，領郡大中正。
units.en: He became the chancellor's libationer-consultant and acting chief evaluator.
units.literal: Transferred to Chancellor's army Libationer Consultant—acting provincial senior impartial judge.

units.zh: 譚薦干寶、范珧於朝，乃上箋求退曰：「譚聞霸主遠聽，以求才為務；
units.en: He recommended Gan Bao and Fan Yao, then asked to retire: "Rulers listen for talent.
units.literal: Tan recommended Gan Bao and Fan Yao to court—thereupon presented memorial seeking retirement saying: "Tan has heard the hegemon listens far—takes seeking talent as task;

units.zh: 僚屬量身，以審己為分。
units.en: Staff must know their limits.
units.literal: subordinates measure body—take examining self as duty.

units.zh: 故疏廣告老，漢宣不違其志；
units.en: Shu Guang retired—Xuandi let him;
units.literal: Hence Shu Guang announced old age—Han Xuandi did not oppose his intent;

units.zh: 幹木偃息，文侯就式其廬。
units.en: Duan Ganmu stayed home—Marquis Wen bowed from his cart.
units.literal: Duan Ganmu rested at home—Marquis Wen of Wei lowered carriage railing before his hut.

units.zh: 譚無古人之賢，竊有懷遠之慕。
units.en: I lack ancient virtue yet long to withdraw.
units.literal: Tan lacks the worthies of antiquity—yet privately harbors longing for distant withdrawal.

units.zh: 自登清顯，出入二載，執筆無贊事之功，拾遺無補闕之績；
units.en: Two years in high office—no deeds worth praise;
units.literal: Since ascending clear prominence—entering and exiting two years—holding brush achieved no praise-worthy tasks—picking omissions none mending gaps merit;

units.zh: 過在納言，暗於舉善；
units.en: I accepted speech yet failed to lift good men;
units.literal: fault lies in accepting counsel—dark on recommending good;

units.zh: 狂寇未賓，復乏謀策。
units.en: rebels remain unsubdued—I offered no plans.
units.literal: mad bandits not yet guest—again lacking stratagem.

units.zh: 年向七十，志力日衰，素餐無勞，實宜辭退。
units.en: Near seventy, fading—I eat unearned rice—should retire.
units.literal: Age nearing seventy—mind and strength daily failing—eating free meals without labor—truly fitting to resign retire.

units.zh: 謹奉還所假左丞相軍諮祭酒版。」
units.en: I return the Libationer Consultant seal."
units.literal: Respectfully return the borrowed tablet of Left Chancellor army Libationer Consultant."

units.zh: 不聽。
units.en: The court refused.
units.literal: Not permitted.

units.zh: 建武初，授秘書監，固讓不拜。
units.en: Jianwu named him palace librarian—he declined.
units.literal: At the beginning of Jianwu—appointed Director of the Palace Library—firmly declined not accepting.

units.zh: 太興初，拜前軍，以疾復轉秘書監。
units.en: Taixing made him Forward General—illness moved him back to librarian.
units.literal: At the beginning of Taixing—appointed Forward General—because of illness transferred again to Director of the Palace Library.

units.zh: 自負宿名，恆怏怏不得志。
units.en: Proud of old fame he stayed restless.
units.literal: He bore himself on old reputation—always discontented without achieving his aims.

units.zh: 時晉陵硃鳳、吳郡吳震並學行清修，老而未調，譚皆薦為著作佐郎。
units.en: He recommended aged scholars Zhu Feng and Wu Zhen as assistant editors.
units.literal: At that time Zhu Feng of Jinling and Wu Zhen of Wu commandery both learning and conduct pure cultivated—old yet unreassigned—Tan all recommended as Assistant Editorial Directors.

units.zh: 或問譚曰：「諺言人之相去，如九牛毛，寧有此理乎？」
units.en: Someone asked Tan, "The proverb says that among men the distance apart is like nine ox hairs—can there really be such a principle?"
units.literal: Someone asked Tan saying: "The proverb says men apart from one another are like nine ox hairs—can there be this principle?"

units.zh: 譚對曰：「昔許由、巢父讓天子之貴，市道小人爭半錢之利，此之相去，何啻九牛毛也！」
units.en: Tan answered, "Of old Xu You and Chao Fu yielded the Son of Heaven's nobility, while market-lane petty men fought over half-cash profit—the distance between such men, how is it only nine ox hairs!"
units.literal: Tan answered: "Of old Xu You and Chao Fu yielded the Son of Heaven's nobility—market-lane petty men wrangled over half-coin profit—this distance apart—how only nine ox hairs!"

units.zh: 聞者稱善。
units.en: Listeners approved.
units.literal: Hearers praised good.

units.zh: 戴若思弟邈，則譚女婿也。
units.en: Dai Yuan's brother Dai Miao married Tan's daughter.
units.literal: Dai Ruosi's younger brother Miao was Tan's son-in-law.

units.zh: 譚平生時常抑若思而進邈，若思每銜之。
units.en: Tan favored Miao over Dai Yuan—Yuan nursed a grudge.
units.literal: Tan through life often suppressed Ruosi and advanced Miao—Ruosi always harbored resentment.

units.zh: 殆用事，恆毀譚於帝，由是官塗不至。
units.en: Once Yuan held sway he maligned Tan to the throne—Tan rose no higher.
units.literal: When he came to authority—constantly slandered Tan to the emperor—thereby Tan's official path did not reach.

units.zh: 譚每懷觖望，嘗從容言於帝曰：「臣已老矣，將待死秘閣。
units.en: Tan told the emperor calmly, "I am old—I shall die a minor clerk in the archives.
units.literal: Tan always harbored disappointment—once calmly said to the emperor: "Your servant is already old—will await death in the secret pavilion.

units.zh: 汲黯之言，復存於今。」
units.en: Ji An's complaint lives again in me."
units.literal: Ji An's words—again exist today."

units.zh: 帝不懌。
units.en: The emperor took offense.
units.literal: The emperor was not pleased.

units.zh: 久之，加散騎常侍，屢以疾辭。
units.en: Later he gained cadet attendant rank but often pleaded illness.
units.literal: After long—added Regular Attendant—Cadet—repeatedly declined citing illness.

units.zh: 及王敦作逆，譚疾甚，不能入省，坐免。
units.en: When Wang Dun rebelled Tan was too sick for court—stripped of office.
units.literal: When Wang Dun rebelled—Tan was gravely ill—could not enter the palace—by seat dismissed.

units.zh: 卒於家。
units.en: He died at home.
units.literal: Died at home.

units.zh: 贈光祿大夫，金章紫綬，加散騎常侍，諡曰胡。
units.en: They honored him as Brilliant Household Minister with gold seal and purple ribbon, cadet attendant post, and the posthumous name Hu.
units.literal: Posthumously gifted Minister of the Brilliant Privy—gold seal purple ribbons—added Regular Attendant—Cadet—posthumous name Hu.

units.zh: 二子：化、茂。
units.en: He left two sons, Hua and Mao.
units.literal: Two sons: Hua and Mao.

units.zh: 化字長風，為征虜司馬，討汲桑，戰沒。
units.en: Hua, courtesy name Changfeng, served as Marshal Who Conquers Barbarians, campaigned against Ji Sang, and died in battle.
units.literal: Hua style Changfeng—was Marshal Who Conquers Barbarians—campaigning against Ji Sang—fell in battle.

units.zh: 茂嗣爵。=
units.en: Mao inherited the title.
units.literal: Mao inherited the noble rank.

units.zh: 袁甫
units.en: Yuan Fu.
units.literal: Yuan Fu.

units.zh: =淮南袁甫，字公胄，亦好學，與譚齊名，以詞辯稱。
units.en: Yuan Fu of Huainan, courtesy Gongzhou, rivaled Tan in scholarship and debate.
units.literal: = Yuan Fu of Huainan, style Gongzhou—also loved learning—equally famed with Tan—praised for rhetorical debate.

units.zh: 嘗詣中領軍何勖，自言能為劇縣。
units.en: He called on He Xu claiming he could run a difficult county.
units.literal: Once visited Central Protector-General He Xu—himself saying able to govern a demanding county.

units.zh: 勖曰：「唯欲宰縣，不為台閣職，何也？」
units.en: He Xu said, "You only wish to be a county magistrate and do not want terrace-pavilion office—why?"
units.literal: Xu said: "You only wish to be county magistrate—not take terrace pavilion office—why?"

units.zh: 甫曰：「人各有能有不能。
units.en: Fu said, "Each man has what he can and cannot.
units.literal: Fu said: "Men each have what they can and cannot.

units.zh: 譬繒中之好莫過錦，錦不可以為㡊；
units.en: Brocade tops silk yet cannot sew a hunter's hood;
units.literal: Compare the finest in silk brocade none surpasses brocade—brocade cannot make a hunting canopy;

units.zh: 谷中之美莫過稻，稻不可以為贇。
units.en: rice crowns grain yet cannot brew vinegar.
units.literal: the finest in grain none surpasses rice—rice cannot become vinegar.

units.zh: 是以聖王使人，必先以器，苟非周材，何能悉長！
units.en: Sage kings match tools to tasks—no one excels at everything.
units.literal: Hence sage kings when employing men—must first match vessel—if not all-around timber—how can all grow long!

units.zh: 黃霸馳名於州郡，而息譽於京邑。
units.en: Huang Ba shone in the provinces yet faded at court.
units.literal: Huang Ba made famous name in prefectures and commanderies—yet rested fame in the capital.

units.zh: 廷尉之材，不為三公，自昔然也。」
units.en: Commandants seldom leap straight to the Three Dukes—always so."
units.literal: Commandant of Justice talent—not becoming Three Dukes—from antiquity thus."

units.zh: 勖善之，除松滋令。
units.en: He Xu agreed and named him magistrate of Songzi.
units.literal: Xu praised him—appointed magistrate of Songzi.

units.zh: 轉淮南國大農、郎中令。
units.en: He moved to granary minister and household superintendent of Huainan.
units.literal: Transferred to Huainan kingdom Grand Minister of Agriculture—Household Superintendent.

units.zh: 石珩問甫曰：「卿名能辯，豈知壽陽已西何以恆旱？
units.en: Shi Heng asked Fu, "You are famed for debate—do you know why west of Shouyang is always dry?
units.literal: Shi Heng asked Fu saying: "Your fame as debater—do you know why west of Shouyang is always dry?

units.zh: 壽陽已東何以恆水？」
units.en: Why east of Shouyang stays soaked?"
units.literal: East of Shouyang why always flood?"

units.zh: 甫曰：「壽陽已東皆是吳人，夫亡國之音哀以思，鼎足強邦，一朝失職，憤歎甚積，積憂成陰，陰積成雨，雨久成水，故其域恆澇也。
units.en: Fu said, "East of Shouyang are all Wu people—the music of a fallen state is mournful and longing; a tripod-standing strong state, one morning losing office, piles up deep resentment and sighs; accumulated worry becomes yin, yin accumulates into rain, rain long becomes water—hence that territory is always flooded.
units.literal: Fu said: "East of Shouyang are all Wu people—music of a fallen state is mournful and longing—tripod-standing strong state—one morning lost office—resentful sighing greatly accumulates—accumulated worry becomes yin—yin accumulates becomes rain—rain long becomes water—hence that territory always floods.

units.zh: 壽陽已西皆是中國，新平強吳，美寶皆入，志盈心滿，用長歡娛。
units.en: West lies the heartland—fresh from Wu's treasures—bellies full and hearts glad.
units.literal: West of Shouyang are all Central Lands—newly pacified strong Wu—beautiful treasures all entered—will full heart satisfied—using prolonged joy.

units.zh: 《公羊》有言，魯僖甚悅，故致旱京師。
units.en: The Gongyang notes Duke Xi's excess joy brought drought on the capital.
units.literal: The Gongyang says—Duke Xi of Lu greatly pleased—hence brought drought to the capital.

units.zh: 若能抑強扶弱，先疏後親，則天下和平，災害不生矣。」
units.en: Balance strong and weak, kin last—then peace holds and omens cease."
units.literal: If able to humble the strong and raise the weak—first distant later kin—then all under Heaven peaceful—disasters do not arise."

units.zh: 觀者歎其敏捷。
units.en: Listeners marveled at his wit.
units.literal: Observers sighed at his quick wit.

units.zh: 年八十餘，卒於家。
units.en: He died past eighty at home.
units.literal: Age over eighty—died at home.

units.zh: 史評
units.en: Historians' appraisal.
units.literal: Historians' appraisal.

units.zh: 史臣曰：夫緝政厘俗，拔群才以成務；
units.en: Historians say rule and custom turn on gathering talent.
units.literal: The historians say: Ordering government and correcting customs—drawing flock talent to accomplish tasks;

units.zh: 振景觀光，俟明主而宣績。
units.en: Merit shines when an enlightened ruler appears.
units.literal: raising brilliance viewing glory—awaiting enlightened lord to proclaim merit.

units.zh: 武皇之世，天下乂安，朝廷屬意於求賢，軸有懷於幹祿。
units.en: Under Emperor Wu the realm rested—court chased talent while ministers chased posts.
units.literal: In Martial Emperor's age—all under Heaven peaceful—the court fixed mind on seeking worthies—linchpin bore intent on striving for salary.

units.zh: 郤詵等並韞價州裏，裒然應召，對揚天問，高步雲衢，求之前哲，亦足稱矣。
units.en: Xi Shen and peers hid talent locally then answered the throne—among past worthies they deserve mention.
units.literal: Xi Shen and others together treasured worth in prefectures and commanderies—solemnly answered summons—responded and raised Heaven's questions—high-stepped cloud avenues—seeking among former wise—also sufficient to be praised.

units.zh: 令思行己徇義，志篤周、甘，仁者必通，抑斯之謂！
units.en: Ling Si conducted himself by righteousness; his will was earnest toward Zhou and Gan—perhaps this is what is meant by the benevolent man penetrating!
units.literal: Ling Si conducting himself followed righteousness—will earnest toward Zhou and Gan—benevolent men must penetrate—perhaps this speaks!

units.zh: 雖才行夙章，而待終秘閣，積薪之恨，豈獨古人乎！
units.en: Though gifted he ended a librarian—the piled-faggots regret is not theirs alone.
units.literal: Though talent and conduct early manifest—yet awaiting end in secret pavilion—stacked firewood's regret—how only ancients!

units.zh: 贊曰：郤、阮洽聞，含章體政。
units.en: Encomium: Xi and Ruan mastered learning and embodied policy.
units.literal: Encomium says: Xi and Ruan broad learning—embracing pattern embodying government.

units.zh: 華生毓德，褫巾應命。
units.en: Hua Tan bred virtue and answered the call from reclusion.
units.literal: Master Hua nurturing virtue—discarding headcloth answering summons.

units.zh: 鳥路曾飛，龍津派泳。
units.en: They flew the bird path and swam the dragon ford.
units.literal: Bird road once flew—dragon ford dispatched swimming.

units.zh: 素業可久，高芬斯盛。
units.en: Their plain virtue lasts—their fragrance still rises.
units.literal: Plain enterprise can long endure—high fragrance thus flourishes.
